subject: Staggered commit and SKU onboarding for new product lines
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novavault.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Request: pricing for layered usage across new product SKUs

Hi Priya,

Quick intro — I'm Liam, Head of Platform at Novavault. We're preparing to launch two new products in Q1: a customer-facing chat assistant (high token/chat volume, spiky) and a background embedding pipeline for search vectors (steady high throughput).

We expect initial "pilot" usage to be ~300M tokens/mo for chat + 50k embeds/mo, ramping to ~1.2B tokens/mo across both products within 6 months if engagement hits targets. We have 6 engineering teams that will each spin up separate instances of the assistant; we want to understand how Redwood handles multi-SKU billing, per-team separation, and volume discounts.

Specific asks:
- Example commit tier structures (monthly token commits) and incremental top-up pricing
- How burst capacity is handled and any burst credit constructs
- Whether we can split commits across teams/products and have per-team visibility
- Any one-time onboarding credits or trial pricing you can apply for a staged ramp

I've attached a short requirements sheet for context (Novavault_MA_Pricing_Request.pdf). Could you share an initial commercial approach and times for a 30-min sync next week?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform | Novavault
liam@novavault.com

---
Attachment: Novavault_MA_Pricing_Request.pdf (stub)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novavault.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: pricing for layered usage across new product SKUs

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. Happy to help — wanted to put a starting commercial framework on paper so we can iterate in the sync.

High-level proposal (hosted API, per-token):
- Baseline public rate: $0.00060 / token (chat generation); $0.00020 / token equivalent for embeddings (normalized).
- Commit tiers (monthly aggregate tokens across account):
  * Bronze (0 - 500M tokens): public rate less 10% (effective $0.00054)
  * Silver (500M - 1.5B): commit price $0.00042 / token
  * Gold (1.5B - 4B): commit price $0.00034 / token
  * Platinum (>4B): commit price $0.00027 / token + volume rebate mechanics

- Incremental top-ups: unused committed tokens roll forward for 30 days; top-up tokens between tiers priced at the next-tier commit price until end of billing period.
- Multi-SKU / per-team split: commits can be logically partitioned across "routes" for attribution/visibility. Billing is at account level, but we can provide per-route reporting and optional cost allocation tags.
- Burst capacity: we offer burst beyond commit up to 20% monthly at a +10% surcharge on commit rate; alternatively, reserve a burst credit pool (recommended for spiky chat) — we can earmark 10% of committed tokens as burst buffer at no surcharge for the first 3 months of a pilot.
- Onboarding credit: we typically offer a one-time $25k trial credit for qualified pilots tied to a 3-6 month ramp plan.

If that looks directionally right, I can route a more detailed commercial term summary and a usage-profile template for your engineers to fill. Are you available Tuesday or Wednesday next week for 30 minutes?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@novavault.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:10:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: pricing for layered usage across new product SKUs — approval for staggered commit

Ben / Marcus — forwarding Liam's request and the initial commercial approach. Novavault is asking for: partitioned commits across six teams, burst buffer for spiky chat, and a one-time onboarding credit. They can ramp to ~1.2B tokens/mo in 6 months and have potential to expand to ~3B.

I recommend we propose a staggered commit: initial 500M committed tokens (Silver tier) for months 1-3 with 10% reserved burst buffer and a $20k onboarding credit; then a planned top-up to 1.5B (Gold) in month 4 if usage meets thresholds with a 12-month accelerated commit schedule. Offer a 5% additional discount for contract length >= 12 months.

Asking for quick confirmation on: margin impact and whether we can push the onboarding credit to $25k if we lock a 12-month minimum.

Thanks,
Priya

Original to external omitted for thread context
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pricing for layered usage across new product SKUs — approval for staggered commit

Priya — good framing. A few notes from the commercial side:
- Silver 500M commit at $0.00042 yields acceptable unit economics for chat if we keep quantization/embedding mixes as assumed.
- We can agree to a $25k onboarding credit if Novavault commits to a 12-month minimum and agrees to a 10% annual accelerator on top-ups (protects us on margin when they scale).
- Burst buffer: agree to 10% free burst pool for first 90 days, then burst priced at +12% afterward.
- Per-team visibility: we should require route tagging and exportable CSVs for their finance team; we have no issue with per-route reporting but billing remains a single invoice.

Marcus — please confirm P&L impact for the Gold conversion in month 4 (1.5B) so we can finalize.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pricing for layered usage across new product SKUs — approval for staggered commit

Confirming from finance:
- Approve $25k onboarding credit conditioned on 12-month minimum and a non-refundable first-month commit draw.
- Approve 10% free burst buffer for first 90 days.
- Gold conversion (1.5B @ $0.00034) validated; margin at that level is thin but acceptable if we: (1) require a forecast, (2) include a 10% overage protection where top-ups beyond forecast are billed at next-tier commit price, (3) include a 30-day lookback for usage anomalies.
- Recommend adding a clause: we will review quantization & batching guidance (Optimize suggestions) during onboarding; if they adopt recommended optimizations we will keep pricing as committed; failure to adopt could trigger a re-rate.

I'll sign off on the final term sheet once legal confirms standard SLA exceptions.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Subject: Commercial terms and next steps — Novavault pilot + staged ramp (DocuSign link)

Liam — thanks for the sync earlier today. Per our discussion and internal approvals, please find the agreed commercial highlights below:

Agreed commercial summary:
- Pilot (Months 1–3): 500M committed tokens / month (Silver) at $0.00042 per token.
- Burst: 10% free burst buffer monthly for first 90 days; post-pilot burst charged at +12% above commit pricing.
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to the first invoice, conditional on a 12-month minimum commitment and a non-refundable first-month draw.
- Ramp: Planned top-up to 1.5B / month (Gold) in month 4 if agreed forecast thresholds met. Gold pricing: $0.00034 per token.
- Multi-team: Commits will be partitioned into 6 logical routes for per-team visibility. Billing remains consolidated; we will provide per-route CSV exports for internal allocation.
- Overages & protection: Top-ups are billed at next-tier commit price; we retain a 30-day lookback for anomalous spikes.
- Optimization clause: Novavault agrees to evaluate Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization). Sustained failure to implement may trigger re-rate after 60 days.

Next steps:
1) I've attached the commercial term summary (Novavault_Commercial_Term_Summary.pdf) and the usage_profile_template.csv for your engineers to complete.
2) Please confirm legal contact for contract routing and I'll send the DocuSign envelope for signature: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123456789
3) Once signed, we'll schedule onboarding with our Optimize team and set up per-route reporting.

If you're OK, I'll finalize the DocuSign package with the 12-month minimum and onboarding credit clause.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
